name: Dimitrios Papadopoulos
bio:
Dimitrios discovered his passion for motorsport through his grandfather, a mechanic who worked on rally cars in his youth. He pursued a degree in accounting and finance, aiming to combine his analytical skills with his love for racing. After graduating, Dimitrios started his career at a small accounting firm, quickly gaining experience in financial planning and analysis. He transitioned to motorsport three years ago, joining a small racing team as a junior financial analyst. 

He quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a knack for identifying cost-saving opportunities and improving budget management. Dimitrios believes in a transparent and collaborative approach to finance, working closely with engineers and team managers to ensure financial decisions align with the team's overall goals. He is known for his ability to stay calm under pressure and his meticulous attention to detail, ensuring financial stability and compliance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Dimitrios is a man of average height with a strong build.

quirks: Always has a cup of strong Greek coffee on his desk.
Carries a small worry stone in his pocket and fiddles with it during stressful meetings.
Insists on using a physical ledger alongside digital spreadsheets.
